newsitem.title: JAPAN: Stock market fall unlikely to affect economy--MOF.
newsitem.headline: Stock market fall unlikely to affect economy--MOF.

text.p: The plunge in the Tokyo stock market is unlikely to affect Japan's economy, Vice Finance Minister Tadashi Ogawa told reporters on Thursday.
"The Japanese economy is unlikely to be affected by stock price movements," he said.

Asked if the recent plunge in the key Tokyo stock market index would gravely affect Japan's financial institutions, Ogawa said he would not like to link daily stock price moves in specific sectors with the business of the companies in those sectors.
"Earnings of Japan's financial institutions are not influenced by stock price moves alone," he said.
However, Ogawa said the ministry was keeping a close watch on moves in the Tokyo stock market.
He said the Japanese economy had been supported by huge amount of public demand but the situation has changed. Ogawa has said that private demand is now supporting the economy.
